name: Memory-based signal source separation and categorization

mentions.name: Memory-based signal source separation and categorization
mentions.description: This project performs signal analysis to drive desired signal-triggered actions, grouping, categorizing, and stratifying signals into useful buckets. It addresses shortcomings of blind source separation, which repeatedly guesses at sources and labels them as brand new, by keeping a memory of previously identified sources so distinctions persist across samples, analogous to how humans can tell pianos from drums and remember the distinction across songs.
mentions.problem: Blind source separation continuously guesses at sources and labels them as brand new instead of having a memory of previously identified sources.
